summary: ingest status probes existence, not coverage — node 10/12 report done when most chunks are untagged
description:
After a partial re-chunk, `guru ingest status yoga-sutras-book-02` reported

  [x] 10-tag-concepts   Propose chunk-concept tags

with 3 of 55 chunks tagged. Measured immediately after the cascade delete:

  book 01: 51 chunks | tagged 51 | embedded 51
  book 02: 55 chunks | tagged  3 | embedded  3     <- reports [x]
  book 03: 55 chunks | tagged 32 | embedded 32     <- reports [x]
  book 04: 34 chunks | tagged 34 | embedded 34

The probes ask "do any staged_tags / chunk_embeddings rows exist for this
text", not "does every chunk have them". One surviving chunk satisfies the
node.

## Why this one bites harder than 4264c23f

Node 11's gate is "no pending staged_tags remain". With 52 chunks carrying no
tags at all, that is trivially true — so 10 reports done, 11 reports done, and
the text walks to node 12 with 52 untagged chunks and nothing anywhere saying
so. A driver following `status` faithfully produces a silently under-tagged
corpus. I only caught it because I had just deleted the rows and knew the
count should be 55.

Nodes 07 and 08 do NOT have this problem — they compare against the chunk
files on disk and correctly reported "chunk files changed after it was
recorded". Node 09 is also correct: "3 chunk nodes in db but 55 chunk files on
disk". So the pattern for a coverage-aware probe already exists in this file;
10, 12 and 13 just do not use it.

## Suggested shape

Probe coverage against the chunk files on disk, the way 09 does:

  [!] 10-tag-concepts   3 of 55 chunks have staged_tags
  [!] 12-embed          3 of 55 chunks embedded

Anything short of full coverage should be `[!]`, not `[x]` — a partial run is
a more dangerous state than an unstarted one, because it looks finished.

## Related

- 4264c23f  status cannot represent "reviewed, awaiting apply"
- e9e17188  node 11 gate cannot close in one apply cycle after a reassign

All three are the same underlying issue: the status machine models the happy
path and has no vocabulary for partial or in-flight states.

resolution.note: Node 10 now LEFT JOINs tagging_progress. Node 13 deliberately left as an existence probe — similarity-gated proposals mean per-chunk coverage is not the invariant, and propose_edges has no progress record; reasoning left in the probe.
